Class SwerveDrive

java.lang.Object
yams.core.mechanisms.swerve.SwerveDrive
yams.commands2.swerve.SwerveDrive
public class SwerveDrive extends SwerveDrive
Command-based extension of SwerveDrive that adds the Subsystem binding and Command factories.

The typical pattern is to wrap SwerveDrive inside a WPILib SubsystemBase. 

public class SwerveSubsystem extends SubsystemBase {
    private final SwerveDrive drive;

    public SwerveSubsystem() {
        drive = new SwerveDrive(new SwerveDriveConfig(this, modules)....);
    }

    public Command driveWithJoystick(CommandXboxController controller) {
        return drive.drive(() -> new ChassisVelocities(...));
    }

    public Command driveFieldRelative(Supplier<ChassisVelocities> speedsSupplier) {
        return run(() -> drive.setFieldRelativeChassisSpeeds(speedsSupplier.get()))
            .withName("Drive Field Relative");
    }
}

      public SwerveDrive(SwerveDriveConfig config)
      Construct a SwerveDrive.
      Parameters:
      config - SwerveDriveConfig to use, with a Subsystem set via withSubsystem(Subsystem).
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - on a real robot (not in simulation), if no gyro supplier was set with withGyro(Supplier).
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if a module's drive motor has no mechanism circumference configured (e.g. via SwerveModuleConfig.withWheelRadius(Distance)).

    • driveToPose

      public org.wpilib.command2.Command driveToPose(org.wpilib.math.geometry.Pose2d pose)
      Drive the robot to the given pose.
      Parameters:
      pose - Pose2d to drive the robot to. Field relative, blue-origin where 0deg is facing towards RED
      Returns:
      Command that drives the robot toward the given pose until interrupted.
      Throws:
      SwerveDriveConfigurationException - when the returned command runs, if the translation PID controller is not configured.
      SwerveDriveConfigurationException - when the returned command runs, if the rotation PID controller is not configured.
      IllegalStateException - when the returned command runs, if a gyro angular velocity scale factor is configured but no gyro supplier was set with withGyro(Supplier).
      Implementation Note:
      Not compatible with AdvantageKit
